skill.summary: Automate GitHub tasks including advanced issue management, PR analysis, release creation with notes, repo stats, webhook triggers, and email support.

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of SkillForge GitHub Automation Skill.

- Automates GitHub Issues (create, list, update, categorize).
- Assists with PR review (summary analysis, changed file stats, review checklist, conflict checks).
- Supports Release automation (create releases, auto release notes, draft/pre-release).
- Provides repo analytics (statistics, health scoring, rate limit alerts).
- Multiple paid plans (Lite, Pro, Enterprise) with feature comparison.
- License key authentication and USDT (TRC-20) payment-only.
- Offers referral rewards and dedicated support channels per plan.
